### Want to become an SDSA sponsor? 

Visit [GiveASA](https://secure.qgiv.com/for/amestaass)!  

To support SDSA activities, you may donate to the ASA 'Section & Interest Group Fund.' While gifts can't be restricted directly to SDSA, this fund is the mechanism ASA uses to provide financial support to sections and interest groups when they request. To be recognized by the SDSA for your support, please write in "SDSA" in the notes section on the donation page.
